name: Rédics (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rédics (a quartered red, blue and green shield with a bird, a bunch of grapes, a ploughshare and a gate) surrounded by the words RÉDICS KÖZSÉG ÖNKORMÁNYZATA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
